name: draw-better-svg
description: Plan, draw, render-check, and repair editable SVG graphics with type-specific geometry, small library recipes, and rendered visual review.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, draw, render, and refine editable SVG graphics
interface.longDescription: Classify an SVG task, plan its geometry, draw in composition, structure, geometry, and style passes, render it at the target sizes, and repair the most visible defects. Includes a dependency-free structural SVG audit and optional Node tools for rendered previews and conservative optimization.
defaultPrompt: Draw an editable SVG icon and check it at 24 and 48 px.
Audit this SVG and fix its most visible defects.
Plan the geometry for an SVG illustration of my brief.
